desc:
Holy shit, Marisa [**does**](https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Embodiment_of_Scarlet_Devil/Story/Marisa%27s_Scenario#Final_Stage) say it like that in *EoSD*. While it's definitely picking on the fact that Remilia's the mistress of the house, it still did come out of nowhere though. Remilia doesn't speak noble polite.

And I thought there's not much ground for the idea that Marisa used to be an ojō-sama beyond being a daughter of a merchant.
